fix.item: editor button dialog looked broken in the frontend with site templates that do not style Joomla dialogs (e.g. Gantry)
editor button dialog in the frontend had empty space below the form and a scrollbar

change.item: content plugin rebuilt as a Joomla 5/6 plugin (namespace, service provider, event subscriber)
all texts of both plugins are in language files (en-GB), so they can be translated
removed leftover Joomla 4 code and deprecated database calls (getQuery(true), CMSObject)

security.item: url parameters (search, nameddest, zoom, pagemode, phrase, highlight) could inject HTML/JavaScript into the page
jdownloadsid is now always an integer (SQL query for pdfimage)

fix.item: popups on one page could get the same id

addition.item: content plugin and editor button are now installed together as one package (pkg_pdfviewer)
editor button rebuilt for Joomla 5 and 6, with its own default settings

change.item: linktext, width and height are escaped
pdfimage shows a clear message when Imagick is missing and no longer shows server paths to visitors
